strings.zh: 1 FTU = 從食指尖到第一指節的長度(成人手指),約 0.5 g 藥膏、可塗滿成人 2 個手掌(300 cm²)。嬰兒劑量按體型減半。
strings.en: 1 FTU = the amount from adult fingertip to first interphalangeal joint (~0.5 g cream); covers ~2 adult palms (300 cm²). Halve dose proportionally for infants.

strings.zh: 核可 ≥ 3 個月;每天 2 次。台灣可取得;主要用於輕中度異膚、優點為非類固醇、非 TCI。
strings.en: Approved for ≥ 3 months; twice daily. Available in Taiwan; primarily for mild-moderate AD; advantages: non-steroidal, non-TCI.

strings.zh: 魚鱗癬 / 掌紋增多 / 毛孔角化
立即型皮膚反應 / 血清 IgE 升高
strings.en: Immediate-type skin reactivity / elevated serum IgE

非特異性皮膚炎(手腳濕疹、乳頭濕疹、唇炎)

strings.en: FDA boxed warning (theoretical malignancy risk) — 20 years of safety data show no increase; Werfel 2024 considers short-to-mid-term use safe

strings.zh: 感染期(疹、皰疹)暫停使用
合併蕁麻疹 / 血管性水腫 / 過敏性休克病史
反覆嚴重發作 + 治療反應差
strings.en: Recurrent severe flares + poor treatment response

strings.zh: 納入 162 位 6 個月-5 歲中重度異膚兒童(失敗外用治療)
strings.en: Enrolled 162 children aged 6 months–5 years with moderate-severe AD (failed topical therapy)

strings.zh: Dupilumab + 低強度外用類固醇 vs 安慰劑 + 外用類固醇
strings.en: Dupilumab + low-potency topical steroid vs placebo + topical steroid

strings.zh: 結膜炎 5% vs 0%(略增加但溫和)
無嚴重不良反應、無病人因副作用停藥
strings.en: No serious adverse events; no patient discontinuation due to AEs

strings.zh: 結膜炎:6 月-5 歲約 5%,可用人工淚液處理
strings.en: Conjunctivitis: ~5% in 6-month-to-5-year-old children; managed with artificial tears

strings.zh: 注射部位反應:輕微、暫時
長期安全性資料目前 5 年以上、未見惡性腫瘤增加
strings.en: Long-term safety data now exceed 5 years; no increase in malignancy observed

strings.zh: 低過敏配方奶在沒有牛奶蛋白過敏家族史時 — 沒有額外保護
strings.en: Hypoallergenic formula in absence of cow's milk allergy family history — no additional protection

strings.zh: 益生菌 — 數據混合、目前 Werfel 2024 不強烈推薦
strings.en: Probiotics — mixed data; Werfel 2024 does not strongly recommend

strings.zh: Vitamin D 補充 — 補充缺乏可能輕微有效、常規補充無強證據
strings.en: Vitamin D — replacing deficiency may help modestly; routine supplementation lacks strong evidence

strings.zh: 「家裡保持完全無菌」— 反而可能增加風險(衛生假說)
strings.en: "Keeping the home completely sterile" — may paradoxically increase risk (hygiene hypothesis)

strings.zh: 納入 640 位 4-11 個月、有嚴重異膚 / 蛋過敏的高風險嬰兒
strings.en: Enrolled 640 high-risk infants 4–11 months old with severe AD / egg allergy

strings.zh: 隨機分組:早期攝取花生 vs 避開花生
strings.en: Randomized: early peanut consumption vs peanut avoidance

strings.zh: 3 個月母乳哺育嬰兒早期引入 6 種致敏食物
strings.en: Three-month breastfed infants given early introduction to 6 allergenic foods

strings.zh: 各種食物過敏發生率均下降
strings.en: Incidence of all food allergies decreased

strings.zh: 引入新食物時:單一新食物 / 次、觀察 48 小時
strings.en: When introducing new foods: one new food at a time, observe for 48 hours

strings.zh: 學校保濕乳液:書包準備一份小罐、洗手後 / 中午後補擦
strings.en: School moisturizer: keep a small bottle in the backpack; reapply after handwashing or after lunch

strings.zh: 避免班上養動物 / 共用毛巾 / 在地板毯上玩耍時間過長
strings.en: Avoid classroom pets / shared towels / prolonged play on carpeted floors

strings.zh: 立即積極外用治療:適當類固醇 + 大量保濕
strings.en: Immediate aggressive topical therapy: appropriate-potency steroid + generous moisturization

strings.zh: 口服抗組織胺(第二代,Cetirizine、Loratadine)夜間幫助止癢 + 助眠
strings.en: Oral second-generation antihistamines (cetirizine, loratadine) help with nocturnal itch and sleep

strings.zh: 剪短指甲 + 戴手套睡眠避免抓傷
strings.en: Trim nails short + wear cotton gloves at night to prevent excoriation

strings.zh: 一週內無改善 / 看到膿黃結痂 / 發燒 → 立即就醫
strings.en: No improvement within 1 week / yellow purulent crusts / fever → seek immediate medical care

strings.en: New concept: aggressively treat acute flares; during remission apply low-potency steroid or TCI 2×/week to flare-prone sites for prevention
